messages:
Mara Chen: Heads up — did a quick pass on the org settings canvas. Thinking the current roles matrix is readable but feels heavy when someone has 8+ role assignments. Suggestions: collapse by resource type, show compact chips, and keep the invite CTA sticky. :thinking_face:

Joel Patel: Agree the density is the problem. Could we try a condensed row layout where the role pills wrap into a secondary row with a "+X" overflow indicator? Quick sketch attached (not in thread).

Priya Singh: +1 to overflow. Also a11y note: when pills collapse into a "+X" we need keyboard focus to reveal full list and proper aria-live so screen readers announce the expansion.

Aaron Li: UX nit — the SSO toggle label currently reads "Require SSO for members"; that's ambiguous for guests. Maybe change to "Require SSO for all org members (excludes guests)" or add a tooltip. Which is clearer?

Mara Chen: I prefer a tooltip + short copy change. Long label will break the row. Something like: "Require SSO for org members" + info icon -> tooltip: "Guests can still be invited without SSO unless org-wide guest SSO is enabled."

Priya Singh: Sounds good. Also, on invite flow: when an admin pastes a CSV we show a progress toast but no way to jump to the failing rows. Can we add a small link in the toast: "View failures" that opens a modal anchored to the CSV import job? :exclamation:

Joel Patel: That helps surface errors. Backend note — we can return a job id and a URL /orgs/:org/imports/:job_id/errors — frontend can open that in a modal. Small schema I sketched: ```GET /orgs/{org}/imports/{job_id}/errors -> [{row: 3, email: "x@y", error: "duplicate"}, ...]```

Aaron Li: For audit log navigation: current filters reset when you click a result and hit back. We should preserve filter state in URL params so back/forward keeps you where you were. Minimal change: append ?ts=...&filter=actor:xyz to route.

Mara Chen: Agree. Make it a standards doc item: use URL-query-first state for any list/detail pattern in Console. Priya — can you add that to the accessibility checklist?

Priya Singh: Will do. Also adding: ensure focus returns to the previously focused row after closing details, and that the "clear filters" control has descriptive text.

DesignBot: Prototyping tip: try a compact roles list with 40px token height, 6px gap, and overflow menu. Test with voiceover and 16px base font.

Joel Patel: Quick decision needed: do we ship the compact matrix as the default or behind a feature flag for Dedicated customers first? My vote: flag it, dogfood internally, then roll out.

Mara Chen: Feature flag sounds safer. Aaron — can you create a dedicated flag and include telemetry for error clicks + invite completion rate so we can judge impact?

Aaron Li: Yep, will open an infra ticket and add metrics: invite_csv_errors, invite_success_rate, roles_compact_toggle_usage.

Priya Singh: One last UX copy tweak: change invite CTA from "Add teammate" to "Invite people" when multiple emails accepted — less misleading.

Mara Chen: Excellent. I'll update the spec and push a small copy patch. Thanks all — leaving this open for any quick follow ups. :thumbsup:
